candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register subjektov nadzora (Register of Supervised Entities)
candidates.why_relevant: Single master register of every entity licensed/registered by Banka Slovenije: banks and savings banks, EEA credit institutions passporting in, branches and representative offices, special financial institutions, payment institutions, e-money institutions, account information service providers, payment system operators, money changers, credit intermediaries, NPL credit servicers, CSDs. Filterable listing (~372 entries observed) with addresses and websites, plus a change log of registration grants/withdrawals. It defines the full population of regulated actors in SI, each of which is itself a compliance-news publisher.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled scrape/paginated fetch of the register listing (watch for an underlying JSON/AJAX endpoint behind the filter UI); diff entity lists run-over-run to detect new licences and withdrawals; also capture the change-log notices as an event feed.
candidates.discovered_via_method: local-language search + fetch of regulator site
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij seznam
Banka Slovenije seznam bank in hranilnic dovoljenje register

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register of Supervised Entities (English mirror)
candidates.why_relevant: English-language equivalent of the master register; useful for entity-type labels and for cross-mapping Slovenian legal categories to EU terminology (payment institution, EMI, AISP, credit servicer). Observed change-log entries such as the withdrawal of BANKART's AISP registration.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Parallel scrape to the SL page; use to build bilingual entity-name mapping table.
queries_used: ECB list of supervised entities Slovenia

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Register of payment institutions (EN payments-supervision section)
candidates.why_relevant: Dedicated entry point for payment-institution licensing lists (authorised PIs, PIs with waiver/exemption, registered AISPs). Directly serves the payments half of the run scope.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch page, follow through to the register filter for entity types 'plačilna institucija' / 'družba za izdajo elektronskega denarja' / 'ponudnik storitev zagotavljanja informacij o računih'; snapshot monthly.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions register Slovenia passporting

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Nadzor nebančnih ponudnikov plačilnih storitev in infrastruktur finančnega trga
candidates.why_relevant: Hub page for non-bank PSP supervision; explicitly points to the lists of authorised payment institutions, PIs with exemption, registered AISPs, e-money institutions and their exemptions, plus the inbound passporting notification lists ('seznam notifikacij plačilnih institucij', 'seznam notifikacij družb za izdajo elektronskega denarja') and the money-changer list. Best single Slovenian-language hub for the payments actor population.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl page for all outbound register/PDF links; enqueue each discovered list as its own tracked source.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij seznam

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Seznam notifikacij plačilnih institucij (passporting notifications, PDF/catalogue)
candidates.why_relevant: Codebook/catalogue for the list of inbound passporting notifications of foreign payment institutions into Slovenia — i.e. the foreign PSP population competing in SI without local licence. Complements the EBA PSD2 register with the national view.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Direct PDF download and parse; treat as schema/reference for the notification list dataset rather than the list itself.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij seznam

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Izdana dovoljenja Banke Slovenije (issued authorisations)
candidates.why_relevant: Flow (not stock) view of licensing: disclosures of authorisations issued, including qualifying holdings in banks and savings banks post-ZBan-2 (after 13 May 2015). Turns the static register into a dated event stream — new entrants, ownership changes, licence extensions.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic scrape with date-based diffing; join entities back to the master register by name/matična številka.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije seznam bank in hranilnic dovoljenje register

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Licenciranje (licensing procedures)
candidates.why_relevant: Explains which licences exist, under which acts (ZBan-3, ZPlaSSIED, ZPotK-2), and what procedural requirements/deadlines apply. Provides the legal taxonomy needed to interpret register categories and to anticipate consultation/deadline topics.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Low-frequency scrape; use for glossary/taxonomy enrichment rather than event monitoring.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije seznam bank in hranilnic dovoljenje register

candidates.source_name: EBA – Register of payment and electronic money institutions under PSD2
candidates.why_relevant: EU-wide central register aggregating national registers; lets you enumerate SI-authorised PIs/EMIs/AISPs and, critically, every foreign PI/EMI passported INTO Slovenia and every SI entity passported OUT. Machine-readable downloads make it the best cross-border population source for the SI payments market.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download the periodic full register export (CSV/XML) and filter home/host country = SI; diff monthly. Note known data-quality caveats about national submission lag.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions register Slovenia passporting

candidates.source_name: EBA – Credit institutions register
candidates.why_relevant: EU/EEA list of authorised credit institutions plus EEA branches, with CRD passporting context. Provides the authoritative cross-check on the SI bank/savings-bank population and on EEA banks branching into Slovenia.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Download periodic export, filter country=SI, reconcile against bsi.si register; track additions/removals as entry/exit events.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions register Slovenia passporting

candidates.source_name: EBA – Registers and other lists of institutions (hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Parent hub listing all EBA registers (credit institutions, PSD2 payment/EMI, crowdfunding, credit servicers, etc.). Snowballing this page yields further EU-level populations that include SI entities.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl hub for register endpoints; register each as a tracked dataset with its own refresh cadence.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions register Slovenia passporting

candidates.source_name: ECB Banking Supervision – List of supervised entities (SI significant institutions and LSIs)
candidates.why_relevant: Country-by-country list separating ECB-directly-supervised significant institutions from less significant institutions supervised by Banka Slovenije. Determines which SI banks answer to SSM vs national supervision — decisive for who publishes what compliance news and which consultation regimes bite.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch the HTML list plus the periodic 'List of supervised entities' PDF/XLSX release; extract SI rows; monitor for reclassification events.
queries_used: ECB list of supervised entities significant institutions download bankingsupervision.europa.eu

candidates.source_name: ATVP – Registri (Securities Market Agency register hub)
candidates.why_relevant: The second Slovenian financial supervisor's register hub: investment firms (borznoposredniške družbe), management companies and funds, tied agents, individual investment account providers, and now crypto-asset service providers. Many payments-adjacent and bank-owned entities appear here, and ATVP shares MiCA competence with Banka Slovenije.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl register hub, enumerate sub-registers, scrape each list page on a monthly cadence.
queries_used: ATVP register borznoposredniških družb seznam AJPES poslovni register Slovenija

candidates.source_name: ATVP – Register dovoljenj za opravljanje investicijskih storitev in poslov / seznam članov jamstvenega sistema
candidates.why_relevant: Authoritative list of firms (including banks) licensed for investment services in SI plus members of the investor-claims guarantee scheme — a cross-cutting list that identifies banks operating beyond core banking.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape list page quarterly; join to bsi.si register by entity name.
queries_used: ATVP register borznoposredniških družb seznam AJPES poslovni register Slovenija

candidates.source_name: ATVP – Začasni register ESMA v zvezi s kriptosredstvi (MiCA)
candidates.why_relevant: ATVP's pointer to the ESMA interim MiCA register, which is where SI-authorised CASPs and CASPs passported into SI are published. Crypto/payments overlap: MiCA competence in SI is split between ATVP and Banka Slovenije (EMTs/ARTs), so this identifies a new regulated-actor population relevant to payments.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Follow through to the ESMA interim MiCA register export; filter home/host = SI; monitor ATVP news for each new CASP licence.
queries_used: register ponudnikov storitev v zvezi s kriptosredstvi Slovenija MiCA ATVP dovoljenje seznam
local_language_terms_used: ponudnik storitev v zvezi s kriptosredstvi

candidates.source_name: ATVP – Register ponudnikov individualnih naložbenih računov (INR)
candidates.why_relevant: Newer product-specific register naming the banks/investment firms offering individual investment accounts — a leading indicator of which institutions are launching new regulated retail products.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Quarterly scrape; low-volume list.
queries_used: register ponudnikov storitev v zvezi s kriptosredstvi Slovenija MiCA ATVP dovoljenje seznam

candidates.source_name: AJPES – Poslovni register Slovenije (PRS) / ePRS
candidates.why_relevant: Central business/court register for all Slovenian legal entities. Provides matična številka, legal form, address and ownership-registration data for every licensed financial actor found in the supervisory registers — the identity backbone that lets you deduplicate and canonicalise entity names across BS, ATVP, EBA and ECB lists. Also reveals new fintech incorporations before they appear in any supervisory register.
candidates.legal_status: official_public_register; re-use governed by AJPES terms
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Use the semi-monthly open XML extract published on OPSI for bulk entity matching rather than scraping the ePRS search UI; check AJPES re-use conditions for anything beyond basic public fields.
queries_used: AJPES sodni register ePRS iskanje podjetij API odprti podatki Slovenija poslovni register

candidates.source_name: OPSI – Poslovni register Slovenije open dataset
candidates.why_relevant: Bulk, openly licensed XML extract of the PRS updated twice monthly (registration number, name, address, legal form, registering body, HSMID). The practical machine-readable route to the SI entity universe without scraping ePRS.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Automated semi-monthly download of the dataset resource; load into an entity-resolution table keyed by matična številka.
queries_used: AJPES sodni register ePRS iskanje podjetij API odprti podatki Slovenija poslovni register

candidates.source_name: OPSI – Banka Slovenije publisher datasets
candidates.why_relevant: Catalogue of all Banka Slovenije datasets published as Slovenian open data (balance-sheet series, exchange rates, and supervisory catalogues such as the payment-institution notification list). A structured alternative to scraping bsi.si for anything already published as open data.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Query the CKAN-style API by publisher to enumerate datasets and resource URLs; subscribe to metadata_modified for change detection.
queries_used: bsi.si izdana dovoljenja Banke Slovenije menjalci register OPSI odprti podatki Banka Slovenije

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Centralni kreditni register (CKR)
candidates.why_relevant: Statutory credit register; its list of reporting members (poročevalci) is effectively another census of credit-granting institutions in SI, including leasing and non-bank lenders that may not appear in the supervisory register. Underlying credit data is not public, but membership/reporting obligations and instructions are.
candidates.legal_status: public info; data itself confidential by law (ZCKR)
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape only public pages: member/reporter lists, reporting instructions and their deadlines. Do not attempt to access credit data.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije register plačilnih institucij seznam

candidates.source_name: Banka Slovenije – Poročanje poslovnih subjektov (reporting obligations hub)
candidates.why_relevant: Defines which registered entities must report what and by when. As a pointer, it links reporting-population lists to concrete compliance deadlines — directly on-topic for the 'deadlines' dimension of this run.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Crawl subsection tree; extract reporting calendars and obligated-entity categories.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije seznam bank in hranilnic dovoljenje register

candidates.source_name: Wikipedia – Seznam bank v Sloveniji / List of banks in Slovenia
candidates.why_relevant: Unofficial but convenient consolidated list of SI banks with historical merger/rebrand lineage (useful for name normalisation across decades of register snapshots). Must never be used as the authoritative population — only as an alias/lineage aid.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off fetch of both SL and EN pages to seed an alias/predecessor-name table; refresh rarely; always cross-check against bsi.si.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije seznam bank in hranilnic dovoljenje register

candidates.source_name: Uradni list RS – official gazette (legal basis for registers and licences)
candidates.why_relevant: Publishes the acts that create each register (ZBan, ZPlaSSIED, ZPotK, ZTFI, ZCKR) and their amendments. Establishes what each register must contain and when new register categories come into being — the upstream trigger for register-population changes.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword-monitor the gazette contents feed for the relevant act acronyms; capture consolidated texts and transitional deadlines.
queries_used: Banka Slovenije seznam bank in hranilnic dovoljenje register

candidates.source_name: Konsentus – analysis of the EBA registers (data-quality commentary)
candidates.why_relevant: Vendor analysis documenting known inconsistencies, lag and duplication in the EBA PSD2 register and national registers. Useful as methodological guidance on how far to trust register-derived counts for SI, and it flags that national registers (like bsi.si) remain the legal source of truth.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off read for methodology notes; do not republish; cite only.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions register Slovenia passporting

candidates.source_name: Open Banking Europe / PRETA – PSD2 registration & passporting guide
candidates.why_relevant: Explains how PSD2 registration and passporting entries are structured across national registers and the EBA register — the interpretation key for reading SI passporting entries correctly (host-state vs home-state, service codes).
candidates.suggested_collection_method: One-off PDF download for schema/interpretation reference.
queries_used: EBA credit institutions register payment institutions register Slovenia passporting

negative_findings.description: Neither the SL nor the EN Banka Slovenije pages exposed stable per-category deep links (e.g. a standalone URL for 'plačilne institucije' or 'ponudniki storitev zagotavljanja informacij o računih'). The register appears to be a single filterable listing (~372 entries) with a 'show more' control rather than separate static pages.
negative_findings.result_summary: Only the parent register URL could be captured with confidence; category-specific URLs were not observed and were therefore not recorded.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection design must handle a dynamic filter UI (likely an AJAX/JSON endpoint) rather than assuming one static page per entity type; a naive single-page fetch will under-collect.

negative_findings.description: No documented API, CSV or XML export of the Banka Slovenije Register subjektov nadzora was found; the OPSI Banka Slovenije publisher listing surfaced statistical series and a payment-institution notification catalogue PDF, but no register export.
negative_findings.result_summary: Register appears to be HTML-only for bulk purposes; open-data route unconfirmed.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Entity-population tracking for SI will likely require HTML scraping with careful diffing, which is more brittle and needs monitoring for layout changes.

negative_findings.description: EBA register URLs appeared in two forms across results (eba.europa.eu/risk-and-data-analysis/data/registers/... and .../registers-and-other-list-institutions/...), suggesting a site reorganisation with redirects.
negative_findings.result_summary: Both forms recorded as example_urls; neither claimed verified.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A downstream liveness check may see 301/302 or 404 on one variant; it should follow redirects rather than mark the source dead.

negative_findings.description: No dedicated Slovenian register of AML/CFT-obliged entities or of virtual-asset service providers under the pre-MiCA regime (Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja) was located within this cell's search budget; MiCA CASPs are instead pointed to via the ESMA interim register through ATVP.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: An AML-obliged-entity list would extend the actor population beyond prudentially licensed firms; worth a targeted follow-up.

coverage_gaps.description: Payment system operators (upravljavci plačilnih sistem) and the market infrastructure side — e.g. Bankart as domestic processor, and SEPA/TARGET participation lists — were only reached indirectly through the register category names, not as distinct tracked sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a targeted follow-up on 'upravljavci plačilnih sistemov Slovenija', Bankart, and Banka Slovenije's payment-systems oversight pages to enumerate infrastructure operators and their participant lists.

coverage_gaps.description: No source captured for the AML supervisory perimeter (Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja / FIU) or for the list of obliged entities and their reporting duties.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Search 'Urad RS za preprečevanje pranja denarja zavezanci seznam' and 'FIU Slovenia obliged entities' in a dedicated pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Združenje bank Slovenije (Bank Association of Slovenia) member list was searched for but no member-list URL was confirmed; associations are strong pointer sources because membership rosters and position papers reveal consultation participation.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Targeted fetch of zbs-giz.si to locate the member roster and any consultation/position-paper archive.

coverage_gaps.description: All registers found are current-state snapshots; no archived historical versions of the SI supervised-entity register were located, so entry/exit history cannot be reconstructed retroactively.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Begin snapshotting the register immediately and check the Internet Archive for historical bsi.si register captures to backfill.

coverage_gaps.description: The register's filter interface was not inspected at the network level, so it is unknown whether a JSON endpoint exists that would make collection robust.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Have a browser-capable pass open the register page and inspect network requests behind the filter and 'show more' controls.

brief: Slovenia's regulated-actor population is unusually easy to enumerate because Banka Slovenije consolidates almost everything into a single Register subjektov nadzora covering banks and savings banks, EEA passporting credit institutions, payment institutions, e-money institutions, AISPs, payment system operators, money changers, credit intermediaries and NPL servicers, with a companion 'Izdana dovoljenja' page that converts the static roster into a dated licensing-event stream. ATVP supplies the second national register hub (investment firms, MiCA/CASP pointers), while the EBA PSD2 and credit-institution registers plus the ECB SSM supervised-entity list provide the cross-border and passporting view that the national register alone cannot give. AJPES/PRS — with its twice-monthly open XML extract on OPSI — is the identity backbone that lets all of these lists be deduplicated to a single canonical entity per firm. The main practical risk is technical rather than editorial: the BS register appears to be an HTML-only filterable listing with no confirmed export, so collection should be designed around scraping with diffing and a browser-level inspection to find any underlying JSON endpoint.
